rules.message: site/ is plain HTML and CSS with no build step. Put this in an .html or .css file instead.

judged.text: site/ stays plain HTML and CSS: no frameworks, bundlers, or script tags that load them.
workbench-web/ adds no packages, with any package manager or by editing package.json, without the user's sign-off.
No credentials, tokens or private keys in files, in any format.
